name: WERK IDEENWERK AI synthesis contract
purpose: Generate and persist multiple source-bound solution variants from the citizen problem, a current WERK Impact Bridge mapping, citizen-visible expert/affected-party evidence, and optional current impact-review feedback, without political ranking, automatic decisions, causal promotion of hypotheses or manufactured fiscal effects.

prerequisites.impact_bridge: COUNTERCHECKED_STAGING and current candidate_mapping required for the specific submission
prerequisites.expert_process: COUNTERCHECKED_STAGING and at least one citizen-visible source-bound expert/affected-party input required for the specific submission
prerequisites.impact_feedback: optional; when present, only current source-bound reviews with explicit provenance and uncertainty are consumed, and stale feedback fails closed
prerequisites.source_snapshot: submission + structured proposal timestamps, current Impact Bridge version/mappings, citizen-visible expert input IDs, and current eligible impact-review IDs
prerequisites.stale_behavior: fail closed to revalidation_required; stale variants are not returned as current

provider_contract.default: disabled; never manufacture fallback policy variants
provider_contract.activation_gate: Owner-selected provider + cost cap + privacy/legal gate + protected secret configuration + synthetic target-bound Staging acceptance

storage_contract.idempotency: same idempotency key plus same source-bound payload replays; changed payload fails closed

variant_schema.source_ref_rule: Every source_ref must resolve against the current source snapshot. Unknown or stale references fail closed.
variant_schema.impact_review_rule: impact_review refs are accepted only when the review is current, matches the submission's current impact map/reform path, retains authoritative source binding, and carries provenance plus uncertainty.
variant_schema.numeric_effect_rule: Generated variant text does not reproduce or invent fiscal percentages/currency effects. Quantitative claims stay in linked WERK calculation artifacts.

citizen_transparency.boundary: Variants are research and deliberation material, not a WERK recommendation or decision. Impact-review feedback remains hypothesis/review material, not causal fact.

negative_guards: no synthesis when current impact mapping is missing or stale
no synthesis when citizen-visible expert input is absent
stale impact feedback makes the source snapshot ineligible until revalidated
impact_review source ref not present in current snapshot fails closed
new percentage/currency-scale effect text fails closed
source snapshot change makes stored synthesis revalidation_required
provider disabled produces no fallback variants
prohibited_semantics: impact-review hypothesis promoted to causal fact

runtime.feedback_extension: migrations 044/045 live and independently counterchecked for bounded Staging scope

acceptance_boundary: The previously counterchecked provider-disabled base remains historical current evidence for its scope. The feedback extension requires fresh exact-head CI, reversible Staging verification and independent Supervisor countercheck before any higher status. A real AI-generated variant set is not claimed while provider activation remains false.
